text:
incident-bot: PAGE triggered: elevated 5xx and tail latency for model v4-alpha in us-west-2. error-rate=6.2% > threshold 1.0%. affected: hosted customers, some keys seeing sustained errors. alert links: https://metrics.hosting/redwood/alerts/98321
Marta Reyes (on-call): I'm on it. @Priya @Sam can you triage svc logs + routing? I'm going to start mitigation runbook.
Priya Patel: pulling logs now. spike in kv-cache misses around 13:08 UTC, large seq lengths from a single partner key.
Sam Huang: seeing backend OOMs on instance pool r3-gpu-24. Container restarts correlate with model v4-alpha warmup.
Jordan Kim: QA reported bad outputs matching a prompt pattern earlier today, could be model regression but right now latency is the primary issue.
Marta Reyes (on-call): mitigation plan: 1) reduce weight of v4-alpha to 0 for production routing 2) route v4-alpha keys to v3-stable or v4-safe if available 3) throttle heavy keys >1M tokens/day 4) notify CS & customers. executing now if no objections.
Ezra Cole: agree. recommend immediate traffic cut for variant, keep snapshot for logs. I'll run the commands.
deploy-bot: /api/traffic-change accepted. job_id=tx-7821
Ezra Cole: running:
```
redwoodctl traffic adjust --model v4-alpha --region us-west-2 --weight 0 --reason "incident 98321: high 5xx"
redwoodctl traffic route --from-key "partner-42" --to-model v3-stable --region us-west-2
redwoodctl quota set --key "partner-42" --daily-tokens 1000000
```
Priya Patel: watch: 5xx rate dropping, currently 3.8% and falling. tail latency p95 from 1.2s -> 0.35s within 90s of command.
Sam Huang: instances stabilizing, no new OOMs after traffic cut. rolling back can be avoided for now, but we should keep v3-stable fallback pinned.
Marta Reyes (on-call): CS ping: @Leo Chen please prepare customer comms: list of affected keys, what we did, ETA for full recovery.
Leo Chen (CS): on it. I'll send a summary to impacted customers and add note to status page. draft: "We detected elevated error rates for a model variant and temporarily routed traffic to a stable variant. No data was lost."
Priya Patel: capturing diagnostcs: saving heap dumps and kv-cache stats to s3://redwood-incident-98321/dumps
Jordan Kim: can we escalate to model team for root-cause? > Priya / Sam can share artifacts.
Marta Reyes (on-call): yes Jordan, loop in @model-team. scheduling an async postmortem. For now, mark incident mitigated if metrics stay stable for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident 98321 acknowledged. Severity = sev2. Mitigation action: variant v4-alpha traffic set to 0 in us-west-2. Next steps: investigation and customer notifications.
Priya Patel: metrics stable for 5m. leaving runbook note: "traffic cut performed at 13:12 UTC. will not redeploy variant until model-team signoff."
Marta Reyes (on-call): handing off to Sam for long-form investigation, I'm signing off from on-call in 20m. Sam please update thread when you have root cause.
Sam Huang: ack, will deep-dive on OOM + kv-cache behaviour and keep thread updated. I'll coordinate with model-team on whether to promote a safe quantized variant.
Leo Chen (CS): customer updates sent. some partners replied asking for timeline. I'll direct them to status page and flag if anyone requests SLA credits.
Marta Reyes (on-call): thanks team. marking incident active->mitigated in 15m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
